title: One Way They Differ From Expectations

entries.value: Unusual skin coloration or texture — unusually pale, dark, or scarred
From a people not normally found here — Roman, Saxon, Irish, Byzantine
Much older or younger than their position would suggest
Abnormal temperament for their trade — a gentle warrior, a vicious priest
Overt devotee of an uncommon or controversial faith
Keeps a pet animal that is not normal here — a raven, a bear-cub, a serpent
Eats a food that is disliked or taboo locally
Abnormal hair texture or unusual colour
Wears unusual tattoos or body decoration
A body build entirely wrong for the area's common type
A distinct physical mark — a birthmark, a brand, a missing finger
